facts.fact: GabonReview reports the BEAC launched the interoperable QR Code for the CEMAC on 29 July 2026 in Douala, following adoption of CEMAC/UMAC regulation No. 02/26 of 8 April 2026, a community text covering the six member states including Cameroon.
